notes.title: Hotfix - V2.1
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, a few days ago the V2 was published with a lot of content, but I just noticed that scp 173 didn't work in this update, so I just corrected this bug. I also patched 2 bugs in the V2. Now you can play the V2 without problem. Sorry if the scp 173 didn't worked. [/p][p][/p][p]- The SCP 173 now worked, sorry for bad experience. [/p][p]- Correcte the wrong button to equip the lighter[/p][p]- Correct the sound of breathing when stop running    [/p][p][/p][p]and a lot of minor change, this is only the majors changes.  Thanks to all those who have reported bugs, and thanks to the community for its support!  If you encounter a bug, don't hesitate to post it on the [b]Discord[/b] group. notes.title: HUGE Update - V2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update 2.0[/h1][p][/p][p]Hello, I'm announcing the update 2.0 of SCP: November 2010, this is a huge update that impact the gameplay and the horror experience which will make it much better.[/p][p]I was working on it since a few weeks so I hope you will enjoy it.

The update come with 30% off[/p][p][/p][h2]Main change[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Upgrade to Unreal engine 5.6 (was 5.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked endings : Reworked all endings, also add a feature that can change the ending during the game. [/p][/*][*][p]4 new cinematics for each endings[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the map : new foliage, new atmospheric, and new textures[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked buildings[/p][/*][*][p]New items : Lightings, Battery for flashlight.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked UI : New font and battery life UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Make bodycam effect optional in settings and by default disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Add breath sound when running[/p][/*][*][p]Add stamina system with breath sounds. [/p][/*][*][p]Update to FSR 3.1.4a[/p][/*][*][p]Add new cars[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Artifact and visual bug fixes (thanks to moew for reporting the bug)[/p][/*][*][p]The sky disappeared in a specific position and was affected by the culling distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow's specific assets were glitching; now the shadow is disabled of these mesh[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimisation[/h2][list][*][p]LOD Reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Some "Cast to" function in code was removed (use the cpu)[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimisation for all the new stuffs added in this update.

[/p][p][/p][p]and a lot of minor change, this is only the majors changes.

Thanks to all those who have reported bugs, and thanks to the community for its support!  If you encounter a bug, don't hesitate to post it on the [b]Discord[/b] group.

Discord : [url="https://discord.com/invite/4xXHPc8JZY"]https://discord.com/invite/4xXHPc8JZY[/url][/p]

notes.title: November 2010 V2.0 is coming
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, I announce that the V2.0 is in development and production. I'm currently working on it.
I will share what do you excepte in the V2.0 of SCP November 2010.

- Rework the map (new texture, new foliage).[/p][p]- Engine upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.6 (today the game is at 5.3)
- 4 brand new cinematics captured in real time for each ending and more[/p][p]- New possibilities: your action can change the ending.
- Completely rework the endings.[/p][p]- Performance and optimization[/p][p]- New features: new equipment
- UI reworked, new font[/p][p]- Many modifications: new ambient, darker light, more realistic building reworked[/p][p]- Bug fixes[/p][p]- Stamina system and breath sound when running[/p][p]- And many other minors change
- This is a huge update that's coming.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529721/c030551ac7f8f3277ffbba60d3f08d6840decc05.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update - V1.4
notes.content:
Thanks to all those who have reported bugs, and thanks to the community for its support! 
If you encounter a bug, don't hesitate to post it on the [b]Discord[/b] group.

someone also noticed that the game is on AZERTY by default, and yes you need to change the keyboard settings in settings menu if you want to change inputs.

[h2][b]Major change[/b][/h2]


[*] FSR 3.1 Available in the menue, by default is disable, but you can enable the upscaler to get better performances, the game will still be optimized, but for old hardware, FSR can be usefull.

[*] Adjusting the SCP 173 speed 

[*] TV in spawn has been replaced by radio for the main menu sound

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]

[*] Fix the bug when the game resolution that does not match player resolution


[h2][b]Performance[/b][/h2]

[*] cast shadow has been disabled for road and some mesh that you can't see, better performances

[*] The Refresh time when the scp 173 detect you has been increased, so the cpu will refreshing less
     Refreshing every 0.2Second -> Refreshing every 0.25. The gameplay will be not impacted


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529721/73575695bfd205dd068366eb93e340c3fb94c0dc.png[/img]

notes.title: The game is out !
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you[/h1]


The game is finally out and I'd like to thank everyone who supported me.
The game is finally out and ready to play!
Are you ready to enter the forest? The game has several different endings and the plushies appear randomly in each game, so make sure you find all the endings !

[b]
What's next?
[/b]

There will be updates to the game, so don't forget to report any bugs, questions or problems you encounter via our Discord. Don't hesitate, I'll be happy to answer you! 

[b]
Special thanks
[/b]

Special thanks to Ko-FI supporter to make this project real
Thanks to Sakou, who helped me build this project, and to all the people who contribute in any way.

Louloubiwan
